title: Amazon API Gateway to Amazon SNS to Amazon SQS to AWS Lambda
description: Create an API Gateway REST API that integrates with SNS and SQS

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This CDK application demonstrates how to set up a topic-queue-chaining pattern using Amazon SNS and Amazon SQS behind an Amazon API Gateway. This architecture helps in setting up a highly scalable API that can consume messages/events, fan them out and process them asynchronously.
